metrics.description:
#### Compute Resources
cluster_cpu_usage_percent: CPU usage (%)
cluster_cpu_used_hz: CPU used frequency (Hz)
cluster_memory_usage_percent: Memory usage (%)
cluster_memory_used_bytes: Memory used
cluster_hdd_overall_size_bytes: Total HDD capacity
cluster_ssd_overall_size_bytes: Total SSD capacity
elf_cluster_vcpus_provisioned: Logical cores allocated to VMs
elf_cluster_vcpus_provisioned_running: Logical cores allocated to running (including paused) VMs
elf_cluster_memory_provisioned_bytes: Memory allocated to VMs
elf_cluster_memory_provisioned_running_bytes: Memory allocated to running (including paused) VMs

#### Storage Capacity
zbs_cluster_data_capacity_bytes: Total data capacity
zbs_cluster_cache_capacity_bytes: Total cache capacity
zbs_cluster_logical_size_bytes: Allocated data space (logical)
zbs_cluster_provisioned_data_space_bytes: Provisioned data space (physical)

#### Storage Capacity - Used Data Space ⚠️ Version-Dependent
> The metric name for "used data space (physical)" varies across cluster versions. Select the correct field based on your cluster version.

| Metric Name | Cluster Version Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| zbs_cluster_used_data_space_bytes | ZBS < 5.4.0 (OS < 5.1.0) | Used data space (physical) |
| zbs_cluster_allocated_data_space_bytes | ZBS >= 5.4.0 (OS >= 5.1.0) | Used data space (physical) |

#### Cache Hit Ratio
zbs_cluster_read_cache_hit_ratio: Cache hit ratio - read
zbs_cluster_write_cache_hit_ratio: Cache hit ratio - write
zbs_cluster_readwrite_cache_hit_ratio: Cache hit ratio - total

#### Data Migration & Recovery
zbs_cluster_pending_migrate_bytes: Pending migration data
zbs_cluster_pending_recover_bytes: Pending recovery data
zbs_cluster_migrate_speed_bps: Migration data transfer bandwidth
zbs_cluster_recover_speed_bps: Recovery data transfer bandwidth

#### Storage Performance - IOPS
zbs_cluster_readwrite_iops: IOPS - total
zbs_cluster_read_iops: IOPS - read
zbs_cluster_write_iops: IOPS - write
zbs_cluster_read_write_iops: IOPS - read, write

#### Storage Performance - I/O Bandwidth
zbs_cluster_readwrite_speed_bps: I/O bandwidth - total
zbs_cluster_read_speed_bps: I/O bandwidth - read
zbs_cluster_write_speed_bps: I/O bandwidth - write
zbs_cluster_read_write_speed_bps: I/O bandwidth - read, write

#### Storage Performance - I/O Latency
zbs_cluster_avg_readwrite_latency_ns: Average I/O latency - total
zbs_cluster_avg_read_latency_ns: Average I/O latency - read
zbs_cluster_avg_write_latency_ns: Average I/O latency - write
zbs_cluster_avg_read_write_latency_ns: Average I/O latency - read, write

#### Storage Performance - I/O Block Size
zbs_cluster_avg_readwrite_size_bytes: Average I/O block size - total
zbs_cluster_avg_read_size_bytes: Average I/O block size - read
zbs_cluster_avg_write_size_bytes: Average I/O block size - write
zbs_cluster_avg_read_write_size_bytes: Average I/O block size - read, write

#### Backup
zbs_timemachine_total_out_bandwidth_bps: Cross-site sending bandwidth generated by backup plans
zbs_timemachine_total_in_bandwidth_bps: Cross-site receiving bandwidth generated by backup plans
